procedural: Title: TNF CLI Agent Sync Process
+This document describes the automated process for keeping the TNF CLI agent synchronized with the latest features from Hermes Agent and other AI agents in the ecosystem.
+- **Hermes Agent**: Comprehensive CLI with commands for memory, tools, plugins, tasks, cron, webhooks, etc.
+- **TNF CLI**: Growing feature set but deliberately different architecture - built on NestJS, PostgreSQL-backed, distributed
**Critical**: memory, tasks, cron, config - core functionality
+Instead of static command lists, the sync should:
+- Dynamically probe agent capabilities via API calls
+- Generate a matrix of cross-agent capabilities
+- Identify unique strengths of each agent
